thread:
maria_cs: FYI HeliosLabs just flipped to their prod API key and immediately started seeing 429s on batch embeddings. They ramped workers from 10 -> ~120 concurrency. pasted logs below, any quick mitigation we can push? :grimacing:

maria_cs: ```
[2026-03-21T17:12:03Z] ERROR 429 Too Many Requests - /v1/embeddings (node-sdk 1.4.2)
request_id=rid_0a1b2c3d user=helios project=helios-prod
batch_size=64 concurrency=120 tokens=0
stack: at Request.send (/usr/src/app/node_modules/redwood-sdk/index.js:234)
```

rahul_se: Do we know which embedding model + exact endpoint? Also are they using ephemeral tokens or a long-lived key?

maria_cs: model: text-embed-ada-002 (hosted infra), endpoint: /v1/embeddings, they said prod key (long-lived) from the console. no region pinning, all workers hitting us from a single IP range.

sophie_devx: quick checklist: reduce concurrency, add jitter/backoff, and switch to smaller batch_size while they ramp. Node SDK has a retry config — can bump to exponential + jitter. Also suggest spreading calls across multiple keys/regions if possible.

ken_helios: we pushed prod key because we thought prod would remove sandbox rate caps. we didn't expect the per-key embedding QPS cap to be this low for big batch sizes. what's the fastest change we can make?

rahul_se: fastest: set concurrency limit on client side to ~20 and drop batch_size -> 16. That should drop instantaneous QPS by ~4x. Then add exponential backoff with random jitter (base 150-250ms). If you can pause worker fanout for ~2–3 minutes while you change config, you'll see the 429 storm die off.

sophie_devx: snippet for node SDK retry config (share with them):
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY,
  maxConcurrency: 20,
  embedBatchSize: 16,
  retry: { mode: 'exponential', baseDelayMs: 200, maxRetries: 6, jitter: true }
});
```

rate-limit-bot: [automated] alert: HeliosLabs exceeded embedding per-key QPS threshold (x3) at 2026-03-21T17:11:59Z -> returning 429s; cooldown window applied for 60s.

maria_cs: i've DM'd them the snippet + suggested temp limits. also flagged to sales that they might be a Dedicated candidate if they need sustained high QPS.

rahul_se: longer-term: recommend
- run a short eval with smaller batch sizes to measure token throughput
- consider Dedicated or request quota increase (we can shadow-route some traffic to handle onboarding if needed)
- instrument prefix caching for repeat embedding patterns

ken_helios: thanks, doing the quick change now. i'll report back in ~10m. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

maria_cs: awesome. I'll keep monitoring alerts and follow up with a postmortem note on the onboarding ticket with recommended SDK defaults.

ken_helios: update: after lowering to concurrency=20 and batch=16 the 429s cleared within 90s. we'll do a staged ramp over next 48h. thanks everyone! :tada:
